summary.text: John Bryant is a Democratic state representative from Texas who has represented District 114 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: John W. Bryant assumed office in the Texas House on January 10, 2023, succeeding John Turner, a Democrat.
In 2023 and 2024 he was assigned to the Appropriations Committee and the Pensions, Investments and Financial Services Committee.
His Republican opponent in the 2026 general election is Tim McDonough.
